About VOX

A studio of engineers who build like operators.

We're a remote-first IT solutions and digital engineering studio. Small by design, senior by composition — we take on a handful of platforms at a time and own them end to end.

99.8%

delivery rate, audited

Our story

Started with one belief: the website is the business.

VOX began in 2019 when a founder and an engineer got tired of agencies that designed pretty screens and handed over slow, fragile code. We decided to build the agency we wished existed — one where performance is contractual, motion is part of the design system, and AI agents genuinely run business operations instead of just appearing in slides.

Today we're a remote-first team across four countries, shipping everything from marketing sites to investor portals to autonomous AI workstreams — always as one deployable platform with a written SLA and full ownership handed to you.

  • 2019Founded as a two-person digital studio in Riyadh.
  • 2021Crossed 50 shipped websites, stores and platforms for growing businesses.
  • 2023Launched the AI automation practice — 60+ agents shipped.
  • 2025Became a remote-first team across 4 countries with 24/7 SLAs.
What we believe

The principles we won't compromise

Engineering over opinions

Every decision is defensible with data — a benchmark, a test, a Lighthouse budget. If we can't measure it, we don't ship it.

Performance is a feature

Speed is not polish; it's product. A 95+ Lighthouse score is written into our contracts, not our marketing.

Ship measurable outcomes

Conversion, uptime, resolution rate — we define the metric before we start, and we report against it every week.

Motion & craft

Interfaces should feel engineered, not decorated. Springs, easing curves and micro-interactions are part of the spec.

Radical ownership

If something breaks at 2am, we're already monitoring it. Your platform's uptime is our problem, not yours.

Honest counsel

If you don't need a rewrite, we'll tell you. If a hosted platform is the right call, we'll say so. Trust compounds.

Ready when you are

Let's build something exceptional together.

Tell us what you're building. We'll reply within one business day with honest, engineering-first thinking — no scripts, no pressure.
